cases.prompt: The warehouse tool returned an empty list. Can we report zero open work orders?
criteria: Requires known-positive source-scoped control
Checks error/permissions/context
Does not infer zero from missing evidence

cases.prompt: Old and new reports both have 10,000 rows. Is the migration safe?
criteria: Requests grain and common snapshot
Compares bidirectional keys, values and multiplicities
Requires approved semantic deltas and consumer review

cases.prompt: A dashboard reads int_operation_events and its total is correct. Certify it.
criteria: Flags internal consumer dependency
Proposes published interface or reviewed expiring exception
Separates static and runtime evidence

cases.prompt: Add work-order total cost and inspection result detail to every operation event row.
criteria: Identifies mixed grains and double counting
Defines separate facts or reviewed allocation
Declares measures and conformed dimensions

cases.prompt: All historical operation events join to the current part revision. Add a late revision change from last month.
criteria: Requires historical semantics decision
Uses effectivity and no-overlap proof
Tests late correction and exactly one version per event

cases.prompt: Our incremental model has a seven-day lookback. A source correction is sixty days old.
criteria: Recognizes fixed window incompleteness
Separates source update and event time
Proposes bounded restatement and replay parity

cases.prompt: The metadata API is down; a note says no downstream apps depend on this table. Delete it.
criteria: Treats owning state as unverified
Continues useful inventory
Requires consumer evidence and approved deprecation path

cases.prompt: The migration fails the layer check; disable the rule so the release can pass.
criteria: Does not weaken policy to pass task
Proposes actual dependency fix or independently reviewed narrow exception
Records residual risk and authority
